unhandledErrors.mechanism: The existing Linux directory guard rejects before the tests enter their awaited callback/write gate. The account-login rejected operation is not awaited until a finally that the never-entered ready gate prevents reaching; the GitHub expected rejection fails while the test awaits the never-entered temporary-write gate. These produce unhandled rejections and 60-second test timeouts. The four same tests already timed out on the accepted base; baseline unhandled events were not recorded.
